content: We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly the system expects to retrieve IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? But we need the molecule structure. No SMILES given. Maybe the sample is preloaded? The tool ir_spectra expects no arguments? The function signature: ir_spectra = (_: {}) => any. So we should call with empty object. I passed empty but with key "". Should pass {}.
